text:
Maya Chen: Quick summary of Kestrel-8.5B bring-up + quant sweep (int8 vs int6). Ran evals on instr-follow (2.5k prompts), summarization (1k docs), and long-form chat set (500 conversations). Results below.

perf-bot: Bench run 1995001234 finished: per-GPU throughput 520 tok/s (128 context), p50 latency int8=118ms, int6=132ms, mem savings ~22%.

Maya Chen: Cost math (approx): int8 = $0.0053 / 1k tokens, int6 = $0.0036 / 1k tokens -> ~32% token cost reduction.

Adrian Lopez: TL;DR: int6 looks promising for short-context, high-volume routes. Quality regressions are small but non-uniform: instruction-follow exact-match down 0.9% (mostly formatting), summarization rouge-L down 0.7, chat-fluency subjective drop noted on ~4% of cases.

Liang Wu: Concrete recs: 1) Canary int6 at 1% for two weeks with eval hooks. 2) Route int6 for requests with prompt length <= 128 and deterministic scoring tasks (rerank, extraction). 3) Keep int8 for generation-heavy or long-context flows (>512).

Maya Chen: Product ask -> @Hannah: is a ~1% exact-match regression acceptable for search/rerank flows if we cut costs ~32%? If yes we can opt-in int6 default for summary+metadata pipelines.

Adrian Lopez: Ops/rollout notes: sample routing policy snippet we tested:```
routes:
  - match: {max_prompt_tokens: 128, task_tags: ["summary","metadata"]}
    model: kestrel-8.5b-int6
    rollout: 0.01
  - match: {min_prompt_tokens: 129}
    model: kestrel-8.5b-int8
    rollout: 1.0
fallback: kestrel-8.5b-int8
```

Liang Wu: Metrics to monitor during canary: 1) exact-match & rouge-L on live eval set, 2) production latency p50/p95, 3) token cost delta vs baseline, 4) user-facing error/clarity regressions flagged by QA -> set alerts if exact-match drops >2% or subjective regressions >6% of sampled hits.

Maya Chen: Also added anecdotal failure modes: hallucinated citations in ~1% of summarization samples (int6); re-running with prefix-caching mitigates ~60% of those.

Adrian Lopez: Recommendation for GTN/product guidance: (bullet) Recommend offering int6 as "cost-optimized" SKU for customers where deterministic extraction and latency are top priorities. (bullet) Expose a per-route toggle in console + a quick quality preview (5-sample eval) so PMs can validate before enabling. :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

Maya Chen: Plan: 1) spin up 1% canary today, 2) hook live evals + set alerts per Liang, 3) prepare a 1-pager for GTN with unit-econ numbers and sample diffs. I'll ping when the canary dashboard is ready.

perf-bot: Canary deployment created: canary/1995001234 -> kestrel-8.5b-int6 @ 1%.

Liang Wu: I'll own the eval dashboards. Happy to sync with GTN on the 1-pager.

Adrian Lopez: If we see higher regressions we can try a hybrid: int6 for prefix/cache hits, int8 for creative completions. Low-risk rollout path.

Maya Chen: Thanks — will follow up with canary dashboard link and draft GTN doc.
